page.layout: One column of running text. Printed page 49 at top right. Running head "AD INDOS." at top centre. Marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines "pro summo gaudio", "tur ftolis albis" and "gestant". Signature "D" and catchword "dum" at the foot.

main_text.p: tolerabile,summâ cum facilitate superatur. Breve hoc est itineris fastidium , levisque morbus ex insolito maris aëre contractus, graviorem multò & perniciosam domans cultus divini naufeam, quæ domi delitescentes plerosque conficit: timor verò, aut nullus,aut talis qui mortis timorem abigat; id enim solum timent,ne quâ carnis imbecillitate lapsi , mortem timere incipiant. Naufragus si quis fuerit,ne sibi idcirco Deum adversum opinetur,ter enim se Christi causa navigatem, naufragium fecisse,Apostolus profitetur,gaudet,gloriatur. Lætetur itaque fidelis Evangelij præco,& quemadmodum Iacobus monet, pro summo gau-Iac. 1. 2.dio ducat, quoties se in varias tétationes [?] & probationes incidere viderit, sciens quod exploratio fidei, patientiâ pariat,cujus fructus in vita Christiani summus; certus hoc sibi gloriæ & laudis coram Deo argumentum fore. Viriliter modò insistat, nec sub onere fatiscat; sciens neminem coronari nisi legitimè certauerit:ij enim soli in cœlis vestiunturApoc. 7. 14.stolis albis, palmasq; victrices manibus Ne perturbetur, si aliqui ex cooperarys, Dominus in ipso itinere, è viuis evocarit.gestant,qui venerunt ex afflictione magna, & laverunt stolas suas ac dealbaverunt in sanguine Agni.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout; u/v and i/j normalised. "tétationes" is printed with an accent and is probably a misprint for "tentationes": marked [?]. "cooperarys" in the marginal note is read as printed; possibly "cooperarijs". Marginal note placement follows the lines they sit beside. The paragraph boundary at "Breve" is not marked by an indent; the first line runs to the full measure, so it is treated as continuing. Catchword "dum" and signature "D" are at the foot.
